canonical_title: Google €13B Finland AI infrastructure and nuclear power agreement
treatment: Repeat only for concrete site capacity, accelerator deployment, commissioning milestones, new power capacity, or a material change to the Fortum nuclear/energy agreement.
known_facts: Google announced at least €13B of Finland investment for 2027-2028 across data centres, grid, clean energy and battery projects.
Fortum and Google signed a 22-year PPA covering up to 50% of Loviisa nuclear plant capacity; it is Google's first nuclear power agreement outside the US.
Fortum disclosed Google-linked projects/partnerships in Hamina, Muhos, Vaala and Kajaani, including a 94 MW battery system adjacent to the Kajaani data centre.
reinclude_only_if: Concrete MW/GPU/accelerator capacity or site commissioning is disclosed.
The nuclear PPA, Loviisa uprate/life extension, or new nuclear MoU produces a material binding development.
notes: Selected as NEW in 2026-09-09 LLM Night Lite.
